_doctrine: script-pass common-actions rule (pass-methodology-outline.md section 4, script-pass L10-18; RUBRIC A4.2): video models only act what they've seen millions of times. Judgment test: is this action common in real-life video?

risky.rationale: precise physics interaction — an object arresting another object's motion requires contact dynamics video models have not seen millions of times (script-pass L10-18; RUBRIC A4.2)
sequential precise physics — cascading contact interactions break into mush (script-pass L10-18)
ricochet = precise elastic collision trajectory — not a common real-life-video action (script-pass L10-18)
micro-expression direction — the model cannot render an interior state as a facial micro-movement on request (RUBRIC A4.2: micro-expressions = rewrite)
directed micro-movement of a facial feature — unseen-at-scale action (RUBRIC A4.2)
amplitude-qualified micro-expression — intensity-directed facial action breaks (RUBRIC A4.2)
inch-scale displacement — sub-perceptual motion deltas are not renderable (script-pass L10-18: inch-scale displacements = will break)
unquantified small-scale position change — mush generator (script-pass L10-18)
